epics.title: Standards Hardcoding: TOGAF, WCAG, Microsoft
epics.description: Integrate TOGAF domains, WCAG compliance levels, and Microsoft well-architected principles across all platform data, schemas, and UI. Team no longer needs to manually reference or track these standards.

phases.title: Phase 1: Data Foundation
phases.description: Create /data/standards.json with comprehensive TOGAF domains, WCAG levels, Microsoft pillars definitions
subtasks: Research and document TOGAF framework (domains, maturity levels, building blocks)
Document WCAG guidelines (levels A, AA, AAA, success criteria)
Document Microsoft well-architected pillars and design principles
Create JSON schema and validate structure

phases.title: Phase 2: Schema Extensions
phases.description: Extend /schemas/ to enforce standard fields in decisions, artifacts, assessments
subtasks: Extend decision.schema.json with togaf_domain, wcag_level, microsoft_principles
Extend artifact.schema.json with standard classification fields
Extend assessment.schema.json with maturity and pillar scores
Validate existing data against new schemas

phases.title: Phase 3: Data Migration
phases.description: Populate decisions.json, artifacts-index.json, and assessments with standard mappings
subtasks: Update /data/decisions.json with standard fields (20-30 decisions)
Update /data/artifacts-index.json with standard classifications
Update /data/assessments/ files with TOGAF maturity, WCAG readiness, Microsoft pillar scores
Validate all migrated data against schemas

phases.title: Phase 4: UI Filtering & Badges
phases.description: Add standard-based filtering and visual badges to decisions.html and artifacts.html
subtasks: Create /js/standards-registry.js (singleton loader for standards.json)
Create /js/standards-filter.js (reusable filter logic)
Update decisions.html with filter panel and badge rendering
Update artifacts.html with filter panel and badge rendering
Add CSS styling for badges (colors, hover effects)

phases.title: Phase 5: Testing & QA
phases.description: Validate filtering, badge rendering, data integrity across platform
subtasks: Test filtering on decisions.html (TOGAF domain, WCAG level, Microsoft pillar)
Test filtering on artifacts.html
Verify badge rendering and styling
Check data consistency across all pages

epics.title: Service Health Monitoring
epics.description: Add real-time service health monitoring to settings.html with animated ping indicators for dashboard, backend APIs, Neo4j, GitHub, and LLM inference.

phases.title: Phase 1: Service Health Data Structure
subtasks: Define service check endpoints (dashboard, APIs, Neo4j, GitHub, LLM)
Create /data/services.json with service definitions
Implement health check utility /js/health-checker.js
Set up uptime tracking (last 7 days, percentage)

phases.title: Phase 2: Settings Page UI
phases.description: Build service health monitoring panel on settings.html
subtasks: Design service card layout with animated ping indicator
Add status indicators (up, down, degraded)
Display uptime percentage and last check time
Add refresh button for manual health checks
Wire to health-checker.js

phases.title: Phase 3: Real-Time Updates
phases.description: Implement periodic health checks and real-time status updates
subtasks: Implement auto-refresh interval (30s default, configurable)
Add animation for ping indicators (pulsing dot, color change)
Store uptime history in browser localStorage
Display uptime graph/trend (optional)
Add visual alerts for service degradation
